confirmed.statement: S1: The PDF states, "Participants were randomly assigned to one of three experimental conditions"; the assigned units are participants, consistent with individual randomization. Convenience sampling describes recruitment, not condition assignment.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 3.1 Participants, paragraph beginning "Participants were fifth-grade students".

confirmed.statement: S1: Assignment changed assistance for students' own creative writing: the GenAI group interacted with the tool on computers during writing, and researchers subsequently evaluated the students' handwritten compositions.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, Section 3.2 Experimental Procedure, paragraph beginning "In the second week"; Figure 1; p. 8, Section 4.4, final paragraph.

confirmed.statement: S1: The tool was Deepseek, described as GenAI with functionality similar to ChatGPT and support for multi-turn dialogue. Student prompts elicited generated ideas and writing content, supporting generative_ai and open_chat; no model version is specified.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, Section 3.3 Instruments and Scale Validations, opening paragraph; p. 6, Section 3.4, interaction-log analysis; p. 8, Table 4.

confirmed.statement: S1: The comparison arms match the form: peer collaboration with a human partner and individual writing alone. The three conditions are GenAI-assisted writing (20 students), peer writing (38 students in 19 pairs), and individual writing (20 students).
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 3.1, condition-assignment sentence; p. 5, Figure 1; p. 7, Table 1 reports the same arm Ns.

confirmed.statement: S1: The intervention comparison is between participants. Everyone completed an unaided baseline in week 1; in week 2, each group completed its assigned condition. This is not a within-person crossover, so randomized condition order is inapplicable.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 3.1, final sentences; p. 5, Section 3.2 and Figure 1; p. 5, Section 3.3 identifies the two weekly tasks.

confirmed.statement: S1: The AI arm received an additional tutorial and instructions to use AI as a thinking partner, evaluate and revise suggestions, and avoid verbatim copying. All groups wrote by hand their final output during the 25-minute writing task.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 5, Section 3.2 and Figure 1; p. 6, Section 3.3, first paragraph.

confirmed.statement: S1: The interaction-log account supports the form's description of brief prompting for idea generation, elaboration, and writing support, followed by direct or adapted use of some generated content.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 6, Section 3.4, interaction-log analysis; p. 8, Section 4.4 and Table 4.

confirmed.statement: S1: Regular classroom hours and the students' usual computer-lesson laboratory support the field_rct setting. The document does not report preregistration or a random-sequence generation method; the form does not claim either.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 3.1; p. 5, Section 3.2; full-document review, pp. 1-13 (no appendices present).

summary: The PDF explicitly supports random assignment to Deepseek-assisted, peer-collaborative, and individual writing. This is a between-person intervention with a common unaided baseline, so criterion 1 holds and randomized condition order is not required.
